title: cert.rs: issuer DER encode failure maps to NoMatchingIssuer
description: cert.rs validate_chain lines 73-78: if current.tbs_certificate().issuer().to_der() fails, the code returns SmimeError::CertChain(CertChainError::NoMatchingIssuer). This misclassifies a DER encoding failure as 'no issuer cert found', giving the caller misleading diagnostic information. In practice, to_der() failing on a cert that was already successfully decoded via from_der() is extremely unlikely, but the error should be CertChainError::Other(format\!("issuer DER encode: {e}")) to accurately identify the problem. The same misclassification does not affect the bag-search path (lines 134-141) because that path uses unwrap_or(false) and simply fails to match — the NoMatchingIssuer there is actually correct since no DER-comparable match was found.
